android.desc:
Own your second screen! Bingeclock enables you to do more while you binge-watch streaming media.

* Search our comprehensive database of movies, TV shows, episodes, and more.
* Track your progress through shows by season or by episode.
* Calculate and visualize the total time you spend binge-watching.
* Create themed marathons out of media items and compete with other binge-watchers to earn binge points and make the daily marathons leaderboard.
* Collaborate on marathons with your friends, sharing ownership -- great for watch parties and movie clubs!
* Use binge points to get binge cards, which you can display in your profile.
* Discover new content specific to your TV show or movie fandom.
* And a whole lot more!

Whether you are just looking up how long it takes to watch a TV show or building your all-time list of movies and episodes, Bingeclock has been online since 2014, with an active and growing community of binge-watchers like you.

Make your next binge even better -- with Bingeclock.
